text:
anna_sales: Heads up — Aquila Labs POC needs dedicated commit pricing review and deal-desk escalation.
anna_sales: Requirements: 6-month commit, baseline 8x H100-equivalent GPUs in a dedicated pool, autoscale to 10 nodes, burst allowed up to 12 GPUs for ~4 hours/day during training windows. They asked for a 15% commit discount and a capped burst rate. Need sign-off by Fri EOD to meet customer timeline. Quote ref: Q-239. :pray:

matt_deals: Can you drop expected utilization profile? avg sustained GPUs/day vs peak? Need that to calc effective unit price. Also confirm region (US-west vs eu-west affects pricing).

anna_sales: Usage profile from SE: avg 6 GPUs sustained during working hours (12h window), peaks to 12 GPUs twice/week for 3–4 hours. Region: us-west. Workload is mix of long-context inference and frequent short fine-tuning jobs.

rachel_success: FYI customer wants monthly invoices and a true-up at month-end; no upfront cap preferred. They're okay with committed monthly billing if burst pricing is bounded.

devon_infra: Technical note — autoscale policy: target concurrency = 250 requests/sec for gen, cold-start p95 ~ 400ms on H100. KV cache re-use will reduce token cost in steady state. For sizing I'd treat 8 baseline GPUs ~= 8 slots, autoscale to 10 nodes (20% headroom). Burst to 12 should be treated as billed separately.

leila_finance: Draft pricing options:
```
Option A (slot-based commit): 8-slot commit (6 mo) @ $22,000/slot/month list -> 15% commit = $18,700/slot/month -> monthly commit = $149,600
Burst pricing: up to +50% capacity billed at 2.0x slot rate (effective $37,400/slot-month pro-rata during burst hours)

Option B (hourly commit credit): commit to 3500 GPU-hours/month @ effective $9.75/GPU-hour -> 15% off list -> burst hourly = $19.50/GPU-hour capped at 1200 GPU-hours/month
```
leila_finance: Option A gives predictable revenue. Option B is more flexible but harder to forecast. I penciled target gross margin ~34% on Option A.

matt_deals: Thanks — two asks before escalate: (1) confirm customer legal/regulatory needs (SOC2, data residency?), (2) any special discounts beyond the 15% requested?

anna_sales: Customer is ok with SOC2; they asked about VPC/private but for POC they're fine with hosted in us-west. They pushed for 20% but we're trying to hold at 15% unless we offer shorter commit length.

sam_legal: Quick flag — add SOC2 clause and a burst cap addendum (defines burst window, max pro-rata billing). Use our standard Dedicated Addendum template. No bespoke IP terms requested. I can sign off on template once deal terms are final.

leila_finance: If they push to 20% we can trade off by shortening commit to 4 months or adding a higher burst surcharge (2.5x). Proposed final: Option A with 15% commit + burst capped at 1.5x baseline billed at 2.0x rate, monthly true-up, net effective monthly commit = $149,600.

matt_deals: OK — I'll prepare the internal deal-desk packet. Need a decision: escalate for exec approval or proceed with standard deal-desk approval? If they insist 20% we need exec sign-off.

anna_sales: Customer verbally accepted 15% if we include guaranteed burst cap and SOC2 clause. Let's proceed with standard deal-desk approval. Please include Q-239 numbers and the addendum Sam mentioned.

ops_bot: billing-bot: Quote Q-239 created and routed to deal-desk queue (DD-482).

matt_deals: Got it. Routing to deal-desk now. @leila_finance @sam_legal please review the packet in DD-482. If there are no objections I will mark as approved for signature and send the customer's commercial terms. :white_check_mark:

sam_legal: Reviewed addendum language, all good — just ensure burst billing examples are explicit in SOW.

leila_finance: Reviewed numbers, margin OK. Approving for deal-desk.

matt_deals: Approved and escalated to signatory. ETA to customer: I will send the signed quote tomorrow morning.

anna_sales: Awesome — thanks team. I'll prep a short email to the customer with the committed terms + burst addendum and loop in legal.

rachel_success: Noted. I'll set the onboarding date tentatively 2 weeks after signature. :calendar:

anna_sales: Closing this thread after sign-off. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
